titulo_es: Who owns what? · Pronombres and possession

texto: The reflective possessive «sin/sit/sine» refers to the subject of the same prayer; «hans/hendes/deres» usually refers to another person. «Der/som» can enter a relative.
Read the header and locate the data that answers the question.

frases.es: Maja lleva su propio libro al curso.

frases.es: Conoce a un profesor que trabaja en la biblioteca.
frases.en: He knows a teacher who works in the library.
